content: Azelastine ophthalmic solution is prescribed to alleviate the itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis, commonly referred to as allergic pink eye. This medication belongs to a class of drugs known as antihistamines, which function by inhibiting the action of histamine, a chemical in the body responsible for allergic symptoms. Azelastine is available as an eye drop and is typically applied to the affected eye(s) twice daily. Follow the instructions on your prescription label carefully, and consult your doctor or pharmacist if you have any questions. Use the medication exactly as directed, without altering the dose or frequency unless instructed by your doctor. To apply the eye drops, follow these steps: 1. Wash your hands thoroughly with soap and water. 2. Use a mirror or have someone assist you in administering the drops. 3. Remove the protective cap, ensuring the dropper tip is intact and not damaged. 4. Avoid allowing the dropper to come into contact with your eye or any other surface to prevent contamination. 5. Keep the dropper tip facing downward at all times to avoid backflow of the solution into the bottle. 6. Tilt your head back or lie down. 7. Hold the bottle between your thumb and index finger, positioning the dropper close to your eyelid without touching it. 8. Use the index finger of your other hand to gently pull down the lower eyelid, creating a small pocket. 9. Administer the prescribed number of drops into the pocket, avoiding direct application onto the eyeball to minimize stinging. 10. Avoid blinking during this time. 11. Replace and tighten the cap immediately after use, without rinsing or wiping the dropper. 12. Wipe away any excess liquid from your cheek with a clean tissue. 13. Wash your hands again after application. This medication may also be prescribed for other purposes. Consult your doctor or pharmacist for additional information. Before using azelastine, inform your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to azelastine or any other medications. Provide a complete list of all prescription and nonprescription medications, vitamins, supplements, and herbal products you are currently taking. Notify your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. If you become pregnant while using azelastine, contact your doctor immediately. If your eyes are red, do not wear contact lenses. If your eyes are not red and you wear contact lenses, be aware that azelastine contains benzalkonium chloride, which can be absorbed by soft contact lenses. Remove your contact lenses before applying the medication and wait at least 10 minutes before reinserting them. Unless otherwise directed by your doctor, you may continue your normal diet while using this medication. If you miss a dose, apply it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not apply a double dose to compensate for a missed one. Azelastine may cause side effects. Inform your doctor if you experience any of the following symptoms, especially if they are severe or persistent: Burning or stinging in the eyes Headaches Bitter taste Eye pain Blurred vision Excessive fatigue Sore throat In rare cases, azelastine may cause serious side effects. If you experience difficulty breathing, seek medical attention immediately. Report any unusual or severe side effects to your doctor. Serious side effects can also be reported to the FDA's MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting program online or by phone. Store this medication in its original container, tightly sealed, and out of reach of children. Keep it at room temperature, away from excessive heat and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Dispose of expired or unused medication properly, and consult your pharmacist for guidance on disposal. Keep all scheduled appointments with your doctor while using this medication. Do not share your medication with others. If you have questions about refilling your prescription, consult your pharmacist. Brand names for azelastine include: Astelin® Nasal Spray Optivar®
